title: VPN Setup Guide for Remote Employees
author: j.doe
body:
# VPN Setup Guide

## Overview
All remote employees must connect through the corporate VPN (GlobalProtect) before accessing internal systems.

## Installation
1. Download GlobalProtect from the self-service portal.
2. Install and enter the portal address vpn.acme.com.
3. Log in with your SSO credentials.

## Troubleshooting
If you see error 'Portal unreachable', confirm you are not on a captive-portal WiFi and that port 443 is open. Restart the GlobalProtect service. If MFA fails, re-enroll your device in the SSO portal.

title: Password Reset and Account Lockout Policy
author: a.smith
body:
# Password Reset Policy

## Lockout
Accounts lock after 5 failed login attempts for 30 minutes.

## Self-service reset
Use https://sso.acme.com/reset to reset your password. Passwords must be 12+ characters with one symbol and cannot match the last 5 passwords.

## Escalation
If self-service reset fails, IT can force-unlock the account in Okta and trigger a temporary password valid for 24 hours.

title: Kubernetes Deployment Runbook
author: m.lee
body:
# Kubernetes Deployment Runbook

## Rolling deploys
Use `kubectl rollout status deployment/<name>`. Deployments use readiness probes on /healthz.

## Common failures
CrashLoopBackOff usually means a failing readiness probe or missing ConfigMap/Secret. Check `kubectl describe pod` events. ImagePullBackOff means the registry secret is missing or the tag does not exist.

## Rollback
Run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name>` to revert to the previous ReplicaSet.
